message: 無音
The entire schedule of midterms is finally over.
I'll still feel anxious until the grade rankings are posted tomorrow, but there's no use fretting over it now. I did everything I could.
Alright, time for a change of pace.
I want to stretch out as hard as I can and take a deep breath somewhere. Somewhere wide open with a great view.

name: Synn
message: 「H-huh?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Azel! Did you come here for a breather too? Just like me!」

name: Azel
message: 「No.」
Azel is looking down at the wharf from the hilltop, staring intently.

name: Synn
message: 「What are you looking at?」

name: Azel
message: 「...What is that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uhh, do you mean the big passenger ship docked at the pier? I don't know its name either.」

name: Azel
message: 「No. Further out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Around the horizon? I think that's a tanker or a container ship sailing out there, though... without binoculars, it's a little hard to tell.」

name: Azel
message: 「No. Everything closer than that.」

name: Synn
message: 「E-everything? U-umm, it just looks like the regular ocean to me, though...」

name: Azel
message: 「I know what the ocean is. But what is that pattern?」

name: Synn
message: 「There aren't any designs on the open sea, you know? We don't get red tides or blue tides around here, either.」

name: Azel
message: 「It isn't colors like that. Look closely. Subtle as it is, stripes in shades of the sea are running across it, are they not?」

name: Azel
message: 「I cannot believe there is any regularity or law to them. Yet it would be premature to declare them mere coincidence or disorder.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah...! C-could it be--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, Azel-san is referring to the current rips.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yikes?!」
Melilot-san appears out of nowhere.
This isn't the carpeted floor of the library, so how did she get here without making a single footstep?

name: Azel
message: 「You again. Why are you following me?」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is a misunderstanding. It just so happens that wherever I go, Azel-san is already there.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I get it, you were looking at the differences in the ocean currents. Just like you said, Azel, the sea really is dyed in different shades.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Hmph, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Azel? Doesn't the Principality of Sharo-Ma have an ocean?」

name: Azel
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Azel
message: 「Th-That's right. There's nothing like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. Then hey, wanna go over to the other side of Finis Tower? At this time of day, the current paths look way prettier from over there, you know?」

name: Azel
message: 「No need. I already understand. That is nothing more than the flow of seawater.」

name: Synn
message: 「We came all the way up this hill, though--wouldn't that be a waste?」

name: Azel
message: 「Leave me alone.」

name: Azel
message: 「There is someone right around here telling me not to get involved with you.」
Azel twirls a finger, pointing diagonally above their own head.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, there's someone right around here telling me to stay with you, Azel.」
I point at my own chest.

name: Azel
message: 「Your god resides in a place like that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, the one above your head is a god, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「Not residing there. We merely commune around here.」
Azel waves a hand back and forth in the empty space they had just pointed at.

name: Synn
message: 「That's interesting--is it the faith of the Principality of Sharo-Ma? What's this god's name?」

name: Melilot
message: 「How fascinating. Would you be so kind as to tell me as well?」

name: Azel
message: 「Hu--... It cannot be pronounced in this country's language. Don't blame me if you can't catch it, alright?」

name: Azel
message: 「My god's name is...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see. To my auditory sensors, it registers as complete silence.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I couldn't catch it either.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Hmph.」
It's strange. Azel definitely muttered something. Having never studied the Principality of Sharo-Ma, I can't even imagine what sort of god's words those might be.
Yet, the tone brings back memories that go beyond words.
The fields I ran around in when I was little, the sound of wind passing through the leaves, the sound of budding sprouts, the sound of falling blossoms.

name: Azel
message: 「Pointless.」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, it is exceedingly meaningful.」

name: Melilot
message: 「To me, the encounter between Sakura-kun and Azel-san feels unmistakably like groundwork laid for the future.」

name: Melilot
message: 「By drawing each other in, the two of you are learning and thinking about many things.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Unnecessary.」

name: Synn
message: 「I think I'm being praised, but it doesn't really ring a bell.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Naturally. If I were to put it into words, this is a plan spanning a hundred, or even a thousand years.」

name: Azel
message: 「Meaningless. That far ahead--」
Azel abruptly falls silent and turns her face toward the tideway once more.

name: Azel
message: 「The scenery is beginning to freeze... I can sense faint fractures... It really is going to vanish, isn't it.」

name: Synn
message: 「V-Vanish? It's like this every year when autumn ends and winter's about to start, you know?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel-san, everything visible from here is not dying.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is breathing. Withering yet budding, being born yet dying. Fleeting, undeniable, and precious.」

name: Azel
message: 「What are you trying to say?」

name: Melilot
message: 「This is what I mean.」

name: Azel
message: 「Wh-What are you doing!?」
Melilot-san gently covers Azel's ears with both hands.

name: Melilot
message: 「Quiet now. Close your eyes.」
Seemingly not completely deaf to her voice, Azel lowers her eyelids just as Melilot-san tells her.

name: Azel
message: 「...What is this sound?」

name: Melilot
message: 「The sound of buds swelling as they await spring, the sound of bark splitting open against growing wood, the sound of petals preparing themselves for the day they bloom.」
Yes, that's it! That's the sound I felt from Azel's god earlier!

name: Azel
message: 「I don't know anything about that!」

name: Melilot
message: 「All you need to do is quietly open your eyes and listen closely.」

name: Azel
message: 「Mind your own business!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then instead of the sounds of a peaceful world, shall I offer you my blessing?」

name: Azel
message: 「I'd rather take foul poison!!」

name: Azel
message: 「Hey, that way is where this 'tideway' or whatever is clearly visible, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah.」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm going. Don't you dare follow me!」

name: Synn
message: 「She left... I can't tell if Azel is unapproachable or just honest.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee... She's simply pure-hearted, very much so.」
Melilot-san and I stood there and watched Azel off.
Azel looked back just once, but the moment she noticed we were still there, she scurried off in a panic.
